data.text: Research campaign started for question: Autonomous biophysical discovery mission: Cross-analyze the 3D atomic interface of SARS-CoV-2 RBD bound to human ACE2 (6M0J PDB) with deep mutational scanning profiles (Starr 2020). Discover novel high-affinity, stabilizing interface mutations and epistemic structural coupling mechanisms that optimize binding energy while maintaining folding expression.

tasks.description: STRUCTURAL FALSIFICATION VIA SIDE-CHAIN REPACKING: Fetch 6M0J (pdb_fetcher), extract RBD-ACE2 complex chains. Using code_executor with a rapid rotamer-repacking approximation (scipy-based side-chain chi rotation + steric clash scoring, or Smina docking if available; NO MD, NO HPC, NO Rosetta/FixBB), repack four variants: WT, Q498H, N501F, Q498H+N501F. For each variant measure: (a) min heavy-atom distance from RBD 498 and 501 side chains to ACE2 Lys353 and Asp38, (b) count of atom pairs within 4.5 A, (c) steric clash score (atoms < 2.5 A between heavy atoms), (d) estimated interface ddG via simple Lennard-Jones + electrostatic scoring. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: If H498 or F501 introduces clashes (<2.5 A) with Lys353/Asp38 or loses all 4.5 A contacts present in WT, the shared-contact-network premise is FALSIFIED. If contacts are preserved within 0.5 A RMSD of WT geometry, the premise is NOT_FALSIFIED by this attack (a crude scorer passing does not positively validate the premise; it only fails to falsify it — positive validation requires downstream DMS/epistasis evidence).
tasks.expected_output: JSON report: per-variant contact distances, clash counts, interface ddG estimates, boolean 'shared_contact_network_preserved' for the double mutant, verdict FALSIFIED/NOT_FALSIFIED

tasks.description: DMS DATABASE FALSIFICATION (Starr 2020) — CANONICAL EXTRACTION TASK: Use doc_reader_agent to extract from the Starr et al. 2020 SARS-CoV-2 RBD DMS paper (bind and expression datasets) the measured bind_KD and expression log10 values for: WT (Q498, N501), Q498H single, N501F single, and any available double-mutant estimates. ALSO export the full single-mutant bind and expression matrices for positions 498 and 501 (all 19 substitutions each) to a shared intermediate artifact (e.g., 'starr_498_501_dms.csv') so downstream tasks 1_3 and 1_4 consume identical data without re-extraction. Use fact_checker_agent to verify extracted numbers against the paper's supplementary tables. Compute additive prediction: dG_double_additive = dG(Q498H) + dG(N501F) - dG_WT using dG = RT ln(K_D) with R=1.987 cal/mol/K, T=298K. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: (A) If additive-predicted K_D of double mutant > 5 nM, the K_D <= 5 nM claim is FALSIFIED under additivity. (B) If either single mutant has dlog10_expression < -0.5, the expression constraint is FALSIFIED. (C) If additive prediction supports <= 5 nM and expression holds, hypothesis is NOT_FALSIFIED by this attack and epistasis testing proceeds.
tasks.expected_output: Table of DMS bind/expression values for 498/501 variants, shared CSV artifact of full 498/501 single-mutant matrices, additive dG calculation, boolean verdicts on K_D claim and expression constraint, fact-check confirmation

tasks.description: EPISTASIS SIGN TEST (consumes task_1_2's shared CSV artifact 'starr_498_501_dms.csv'; if double-mutant eps(H,F) is unavailable — expected, since Starr 2020 is primarily single-mutant — the fallback is the full 19x19 substitution-matrix sign test): Using the extracted Starr 2020 DMS data, compute epistasis for the 498/501 pair across ALL substitution pairs available at both positions: eps_ij = dG_ij - dG_i - dG_j + dG_WT for every amino-acid pair (i at 498, j at 501) with measured values. Report the distribution of eps: mean, median, fraction positive vs negative, and whether the specific (H, F) pair shows positive eps >= 0.15 kcal/mol (if measurable). MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: If the median eps across the 19x19 substitution matrix is NEGATIVE (antagonistic epistasis dominates this contact-coupled pair), the hypothesis's claimed positive coupling is FALSIFIED as a general mechanism. If median eps is positive and (H,F) specifically shows eps >= 0.15 kcal/mol (or, if (H,F) unmeasured, the matrix median is positive with bootstrap CI excluding zero), the coupling claim is NOT_FALSIFIED.
tasks.expected_output: Epistasis matrix statistics for positions 498x501, sign distribution, specific eps(H,F) value with bootstrap CI if available, verdict on positive-coupling claim

tasks.description: EXPRESSION FLOOR STRESS TEST (consumes task_1_2's shared CSV artifact 'starr_498_501_dms.csv'): From the Starr 2020 DMS expression data, compute the full expression distribution at positions 498 and 501 across all 19 substitutions. Test whether ANY substitution at 498 or 501 achieves dlog10_expression >= -0.5 while simultaneously ranking in the top-20% of bind scores at that position. Use rank-based and permutation methods appropriate for bounded, non-normal DMS data (n≈38 per position): Mann-Whitney U / rank-sum comparison of expression of bind-enhancing substitutions vs all others, exact permutation test (10,000 permutations) on the rank difference, rank-biserial correlation effect size, and 95% BCa bootstrap CI on the Spearman rank correlation between bind and expression at these positions (no normality assumption; Shapiro-Wilk is deliberately omitted as inappropriate for bounded DMS distributions). MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: If bind-enhancing substitutions at 498/501 systematically show expression < -0.5 (stability-binding tradeoff), the hypothesis's dual constraint (K_D <= 5 nM AND expression >= -0.5) is FALSIFIED as jointly infeasible at this interface. If a feasible region exists, report which substitutions occupy it and the dual constraint is NOT_FALSIFIED.
tasks.expected_output: Joint bind-expression feasibility map for positions 498/501, rank-based test results (U statistic, permutation p-values, rank-biserial effect size, Spearman rho with bootstrap CIs), boolean 'dual_constraint_feasible', list of feasible substitutions

tasks.description: ADVERSARIAL VERDICT SYNTHESIS: Use summarizer_agent to consolidate results from tasks 1_1 through 1_4 into a single falsification verdict for hypothesis d28c4b78. Apply strict logic: hypothesis is KILLED if ANY of (a) shared contact network broken by repacking, (b) additive dG fails K_D <= 5 nM, (c) median epistasis sign negative, (d) dual constraint infeasible. Hypothesis survives only if ALL four attacks fail to falsify. Use fact_checker_agent to verify all numerical claims in the synthesis. Produce a structured kill/survive report with per-attack evidence, confidence scores, and if survived, the specific remediation data still required (SPR K_D quadruplicate measurements; explicit double-mutant DMS measurement if eps(H,F) was unmeasurable).
tasks.expected_output: Final adversarial verdict document: KILLED or SURVIVES with per-attack evidence table, updated hypothesis confidence, remediation requirements

plan.rationale: PHASE 3 SIEGE (revised per critique round 2): The active hypothesis (positive epistatic coupling eps_498,501 via shared ACE2 Lys353/Asp38 contact network enabling K_D <= 5 nM) is currently UNIDENTIFIABLE from static structure alone. Attack strategy: (1) FALSIFY the structural premise via scipy-based side-chain repacking (explicitly NOT Rosetta/FixBB — rapid chi-rotation + clash scoring, N=4 variants); verdict wording corrected to FALSIFIED/NOT_FALSIFIED since a crude scorer passing only fails to falsify, not validate. (2) FALSIFY the thermodynamic claim by cross-referencing Starr 2020 DMS bind/expression values at 498 and 501 via a single canonical extraction task (task_1_2) that exports a shared CSV artifact consumed by tasks 1_3 and 1_4 (explicit task-ID dependency edges, eliminating duplicate extraction). (3) Test the ALTERNATIVE sign of epistasis via the full 19x19 matrix median-eps sign test with the specific eps(H,F) as a secondary check if measurable. (4) Stress the expression constraint with rank-based/permutation statistics (Mann-Whitney U, exact permutation test, rank-biserial effect size, Spearman + BCa bootstrap CI) appropriate for bounded non-normal DMS data; Shapiro-Wilk normality gate removed as decorative. (5) Orthogonality: prior cycle used static geometry + t-test; this cycle uses repacking energetics, DMS database falsification, and epistasis sign-testing — three distinct attack vectors. All tasks are mutually exclusive in outcome: hypothesis survives only if repacking preserves contacts AND DMS additive dG supports <=5 nM AND epistasis sign is positive AND expression floor holds.
